measurement: R3 part 1 (理 11217) — G on seed 47's FULL 300, seed-21 L-BFGS head. The head has never seen any of these problems; zero shared signatures.

BOTH_DIRECTIONS_NOW_HAVE_n_300.reading: the intervals overlap heavily and both exclude zero by a wide margin. Transfer is symmetric at the size where it can be measured properly: it does not matter which set trains and which evaluates. The earlier n=75 pairings pointed at this; these settle it.

and_the_bases_agree_across_three_draws: 18.7% (seed 21), 16.7% (seed 47) on 300 each, and 17.3% on the 75-problem prefix of seed 47. Three independent draws from one grammar landing within two points is the generator behaving as a generator.
what_it_does_not_change: the cost reading. -0.95 actions is a saving in the pre-registered metric; in TOKENS with the controller's own inference counted G costs 34% more (R2). R2b tests whether a batched scorer brings the overhead under 502 tokens/episode.
bounds: n = 300 paired, 10,000 bootstrap resamples, exact McNemar on 78 discordant pairs.
